text:
A study of 1,100 Google users found forced AI Mode cut clicks to outside websites by 18.8 points. Trust and satisfaction fell too. Penn and Northeastern researchers posted it to arXiv in August. It is a preprint, tested in March, and we found no Google response.

Source: arXiv:2608.18352, Aug 18
